content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIA Project Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report on the specified date for the interview. There is no online application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Trainee positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month for both Project Trainee (Mechanical) and Project Trainee (Optics) roles.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: For Project Trainee (Mechanical), a BE/B.Tech/M.Sc in Mechanical/Production/Aerospace with 60% marks is required. For Project Trainee (Optics), a BE/B.Tech/M.Sc/ME/M.Tech in Optics/Photonics/Applied Physics with 60% marks is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 27 years for Project Trainee (Mechanical) and 30 years for Project Trainee (Optics). Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Project Trainees?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Project Trainee positions, with one post for Mechanical and one for Optics.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the Indian Institute of Astrophysics, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560034.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates related to their qualification and experience, along with one set of self-certified photocopies, and a passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the IIA Project Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Project Trainee positions are project-based, indicating a contractual role related to specific research projects at the Indian Institute of Astrophysics.
